invariants.rationale: Deduplication only makes sense if there are records; most methods of this nature expect a non-empty list.
Parallelism is typically expected to be a positive integer for proper distributed processing.
A non-null, non-empty schema string is necessary for parsing the table schema used in deduplication.
Properties are required for configuration during deduplication; null would likely cause errors.
Ordering fields are used during record reduction, so the array should be non-null.
